# commonware-consensus 2026.7.1

This directory contains the published crates.io package, checksum `b8c854f77e510cf97cffcf02723737bca035ee77b1aa9fc7d6dd88694d3c8f0d`. Its normalized `Cargo.toml` and every dependency requirement are unchanged. All other Commonware packages remain pinned to the registry by the Tempo root lockfile.

The package identifies Commonware monorepo commit `da15b3c08ac3a3e8becb2e4742866f07b0112ee8`. The three source files listed in `PROVENANCE.json` only expose the existing Gates, verification resolution, and standard relay APIs; their algorithms are unchanged. `LICENSE-MIT` and `LICENSE-APACHE` are copied verbatim from that commit's repository root, because the published package omits those files. Copyright and attribution are retained.

`PROVENANCE.json` records the original checksum of every published file and the hashes of changed sources and added licenses. These make the branch-local modifications independently reviewable. No wire format, storage format, durability policy, or dependency version is changed here.
